{{Quote|The jungle world of Troiken hosts the indictidile, a spiked insect that curls into a ball and impales its prey by rolling through the undergrowth.|Jedi Master Bowspritz's notes from ''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force''|<ref name="TJP" />}}
The '''Troiken indictidile''' was a [[Diet/Legends|predatory]], [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Insect/Legends|insect]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the jungle [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Troiken/Legends|Troiken]]. They curled into a ball and rolled through undergrowth in order to impale prey on the irregularly shaped spikes that covered their long, thin bodies. The insects had [[Color/Legends|black]] skin and an orange [[Eye/Legends|eye]] located at one end of their body.<ref name="TJP" />

The [[Tynnan/Legends|Tynnan]]<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/31329847|board=Literature|thread=The Jedi Path. (Now you too can actually pretend with slightly more accuracy that you're a Jedi!)|user=[[Daniel Wallace|Dan_Wallace]]|date=2010-10-25|time=1:50 PM|archivedate=20180609035645}}</ref> [[Bowspritz]], who served as both a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and a [[Biologist/Legends|biologist]], included information about indictidiles in the "Galactic Bestiary" chapter of ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]'', a [[Book/Legends|book]] given to [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|students]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]<ref name="TJP" /> that was published around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[990 BBY]].<ref name="Date">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']] was published a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] or more after the end of the [[New Sith Wars]], which ended in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Troiken indictidile was featured in [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']], a book written by [[Daniel Wallace]] that was released in [[2013]]. The book included an illustration of an indictidile drawn by artist [[Derek Thompson]].<ref name="TJP" />
